exposure: use of serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SRIs) during pregnancy
cohort: Singleton births in Sweden (n=2,145,660) and British Columbia, Canada (n=824,100) between 1999-2019
finding: Maternal OCD was associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy, delivery, and neonatal outcomes, even after adjusting for SRI use.
mod_finding: Maternal OCD was associated with increased risk of elective cesarean delivery (Sweden aRR 1.39, 95% CI 1.30-1.49, BC not significant) and emergency cesarean delivery (Sweden aRR 1.16, 95% CI 1.08-1.25, BC aRR 1.15, 95% CI 1.01-1.31).
